title: 第1章 邪性少年第2章 你憨我疯
slug: 看见血条的我选择打爆世界
content_zh:
“上拜天地，阴阳和合、天地为证。
再拜父母，生养之恩、子孙不忘。
夫妻对拜，合卺一体、贵贱不移。”
一个口中牙齿无几的枯黄老汉卖力的吆喝，两个年轻人手持红色麻布依次叩拜。
那新娘穿着半旧不新的衣服，头盖一块红布，虽然十分简朴，但好歹衣服上没什么明显的补丁。
新郎那边就惨了，常服上大大小小的补丁十分潦草，只能披上借来的布匹掩盖杂乱。
周元站在喧闹的人群中，既没有祝福，也没有轻视，有的只是迷茫。
他原本是正经蓝星人，没想到一觉醒来，进入了似是而非的游戏世界。
之所以说这里是游戏世界，是因为在他眼中所有人头顶都有血条，他自己也有属性面板。
至于说似是而非，是因为他穿越近一个多月以来不断旁敲侧击，发现本地村民根本看不到属性面板、血条之类的东西。
他们就是正常的活人，有生老病死、须辛勤劳作，平时也会闲聊赵家长、李家短。
当周元以为游戏化是自己的金手指时，又听到村中长者嘱咐，外出时一定要小心不死不灭的妖魔。
那些妖魔有的很强、有的很弱，但都有一个共同点，那就是不死不灭。
哪怕费尽心思的杀死它们，只要过了深夜子时它们依然会复活。
好在妖魔都有自己的领地，绝不会轻易外出，否则早就没有村寨的活路了。
周元越听越奇怪，不死不灭这种超乎常理的力量，怎么可能出现在弱小者身上。
如此强大无解的妖魔，为什么会自我囚禁，它们吃什么、喝什么，总不能一个个都无欲无求吧。
他结合自己能看到血条的能力，心中不禁生出了一个大胆的猜测。
那些妖魔或许是游戏怪物，它们不是不死不灭，只不过会定时刷新罢了。
可这也说不通啊，如果这是一个游戏世界，人类npc未免也太正常了，不同的情感与人格该怎么模拟。

周元一时间有些分不清，到底是世界游戏化，还是自己游戏化。
“啪。”
一张粗糙的大手轻轻拍了一下周元的肩膀，满脸褶子的老汉开口说道。
“石头，愣着干啥，是不是看到二狗结亲羡慕了。
你甭怪村子不帮你留后，你爹从军走的早、你娘生你那天就没了。
就算村子出钱给你找个婆娘，你从军后谁帮你养啊，万一你运道好再留个后，谁帮你照看他们娘俩。”
“大黄叔，我没那念想，我只是在想县里发的募兵令。”
“有啥好想的，你不会想跑吧，那可不成。
咱们村六十七户，就要出二十三个壮丁，你要是跑了，别的人家就得补上。”
“石头，前些年都是其他户出壮丁，要么从军、要么徭役。
咱们都顾及着你是孩子，不让你去，现在你十六了，都是成年汉子了，总不能还不去吧。”
“哪能，大黄叔，咱也是有良心的，断然不会逃跑害人。”
周元不是没想过逃跑，但村子不放心他这个没有牵挂的人，派了三个有家室的汉子与他同吃同住。
他一个人根本打不过三个村汉，只能先了解这个世界的情况，再制定后续计划。
“礼成。”
随着一声高亢的吆喝，新人夫妇被推入洞房，村妇们端出一筐筐软黄面饼和几碗烂浓鸡汤。
content_en:
“Go up and worship the heaven and the earth, the yin and yang are harmonious, and the heaven and the earth are witnesses.
Worship your parents again, and your children and grandchildren will never forget the grace of childbirth.
Husband and wife bow to each other and become one body, no matter how high or low they are. "
A withered old man with few teeth in his mouth shouted vigorously, and two young people held red linen cloths and kowtowed in turn.
The bride wore half-worn clothes and a red cloth covering her head. Although she was very simple, there were no obvious patches on her clothes.
The groom's side was miserable. The large and small patches on his uniform were very messy, and he could only cover up the mess with a borrowed cloth.
Zhou Yuan stood in the noisy crowd, neither blessing nor contempt, but just confused.
He was originally a serious Blue Star person, but he didn't expect to wake up and enter a specious game world.
The reason why this is a game world is because in his eyes everyone has health bars above their heads, and he also has an attribute panel.
As for the plausibility, it is because he has been making insinuations since traveling for more than a month and found that the local villagers could not see things like attribute panels and health bars at all.
They are normal living people. They have birth, old age, illness and death, and have to work hard. They usually chat about the Zhao family and the Li family's shortcomings.
Just when Zhou Yuan thought that gamification was his golden finger, he heard the village elders tell him to be careful of the immortal demon when going out.
Some of those demons are very strong and some are very weak, but they all have one thing in common, that is, they are immortal.
No matter how hard you try to kill them, they will still come back to life after midnight.
Fortunately, the demons have their own territory and will never go out easily, otherwise the village would have no way to survive.
The more Zhou Yuan listened, the more strange he became. How could such an extraordinary power of immortality appear in a weak person.
Why do such powerful and unsolvable demons imprison themselves? They can't have no desires and desires no matter what they eat and drink.
Combined with his ability to see health bars, he couldn't help but make a bold guess in his mind.
Those monsters may be game monsters. They are not immortal, they just refresh regularly.
But this doesn’t make sense. If this was a game world, human NPCs would be too normal. How should different emotions and personalities be simulated.
Zhou Yuan couldn't tell for a moment whether he was gamifying the world or himself.
"Crack."
A rough big hand gently patted Zhou Yuan's shoulder, and the wrinkled old man spoke.
"Shitou, what are you doing standing there in a daze? Are you jealous when you see the two dogs getting married?
Don't blame the village for not helping you stay. Your father joined the army and left early, and your mother died the day she gave birth to you.
Even if the village pays for you to find a wife, who will help you take care of them after you join the army? If you are lucky enough to have a wife, who will help you take care of them. "
"Uncle Dahuang, I'm not thinking about that. I'm just thinking about the recruitment order issued by the county."
"If you have anything to think about, you don't want to run away, that's not possible.
There are sixty-seven households in our village, and there are twenty-three strong men. If you run away, other families will have to take over. "
"Stone, in the past few years, all the young men from other households were either joining the army or doing corvee labor.
We all considered that you were a child and wouldn't let you go. Now that you are sixteen and an adult, you can't still go. "
"No way, Uncle Dahuang, we also have a conscience, and we will definitely not run away and harm others."
It's not that Zhou Yuan didn't think about running away, but the village didn't trust him as a carefree person, so they sent three men with families to live and eat with him.
He can't defeat three villagers by himself. He can only understand the situation of the world first and then formulate follow-up plans.
"It's done."
With a loud shout, the newlyweds were pushed into the bridal chamber, and the village women brought out baskets of soft yellow noodles and bowls of thick chicken soup.
